Management Plan
- management_plan_main: Assessment suggests asthma exacerbation (likely trigger: viral illness or allergen). Management and plan documented:
  - Advise increase inhaled short-acting beta-agonist: salbutamol 2–4 puffs every 4 hours initially (as instructed by clinician).
  - Patient reports current use of salbutamol (patient-reported baseline dose/route/frequency not documented).
  - Prescribe/provide peak flow meter and spacer; pharmacist to instruct on spacer and peak flow use.
  - Advise taking a regular oral antihistamine (specific agent/dose not documented) available from pharmacy; clinician to note recommendation in records.
  - Patient to record peak flow values first thing in morning and in evening over next week; follow-up review arranged in ~1 week or sooner if symptoms worsen.
  - Instructions to contact service immediately if fever becomes high or wheeze worsens.
  - Consider review for possible initiation of additional controller inhaler if ongoing symptoms (to be decided at follow-up).
